turns.text: quick q how do i log a car repair in a shared budget sheet. iris keeps the household one, i just fill in what she set up. check engine light thing, it was the o2 sensor probably, ~$238. also does it matter that i pay $1,450 of the $2,900 rent, want it to fit around that

Happy to help. A few options depending on how the sheet is set up:

1. Log it as a personal/one-off expense, not a shared one. A car repair is usually yours alone, so put it under a category like Car/Transportation (or Irregular expenses) with your name on it.
2. Enter the details: date, $238, category, and a short note like "O2 sensor, check-engine light."
3. Keep it separate from rent. Your $1,450 share of the $2,900 is a fixed monthly line, so the repair shouldn't touch it. What matters is that your total for the month (rent share + this + your other bills) still fits your income.
4. If the sheet has a sinking fund or "surprises" line, take the $238 from there so it doesn't blow up this month's numbers.

If you tell me what columns and categories the sheet has, I can say exactly where it goes.
it has columns date, item, category, who, amount. categories are like rent, groceries, utilities, fun, misc. no car one

Easy then. Add a row:

- Date: the day you paid
- Item: O2 sensor repair (check-engine light)
- Category: misc
- Who: you
- Amount: 238

Misc works fine since there's no car category. If you want to track car costs over time, you could ask whoever maintains the sheet to add a Car category later, but it's not required.

If your repair came out slightly different from $238 once you have the final bill, just enter the exact amount.
